The report shall include: (1) the total number of foreign fighters who have traveled to and from terrorist safe havens since 2011, including those who have returned to their countries of origin; (2) the total number of U.S. citizens who have traveled or attempted to travel to such safe havens; (3) the total number of foreign fighters in terrorist safe havens as of the date of the report; (4) the total number of foreign fighters who have left such safe havens or whose whereabouts are unknown; and (5) a worldwide assessment of foreign country efforts to track and control the flow of foreign fighters to and from such safe havens.
